'''Skali''' is a Star Wars CCG writing handle on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]]. The Expanded Universe index credited that handle for Hidden Base, speeder, and Watch Your Step lists.<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/XWingHiddenBase.htm X-Wing Hidden Base], The Outer Rim (Skali). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155336/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/XWingHiddenBase.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
